Requirements You are doomed, and your last action was a successful [[/act demoralize]] action.

When you terrify your foes, you implant the fiendish visions of Hell into their mind. The creature you successfully Demoralized takes @Damage[4d6[mental]] damage or @Damage[8d6[mental]] damage if you're legendary in Intimidation. You then increase the value of your doomed condition by 1.

publication.title: Pathfinder Lost Omens Cheliax, Infernal Inheritance
